description: Tavuk Sis is a beloved Turkish classic featuring succulent pieces of chicken marinated in a flavorful blend of yogurt, olive oil, and aromatic spices. These tender chicken skewers are grilled to perfection, offering a smoky char and juicy interior. It is a delightful and healthy dish, often served with rice, fresh salad, or pita bread.

ingredients.item: Boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs

ingredients.notes: soaked in water for 30 minutes if using

instructions.title: Prepare the Chicken and Skewers
instructions.text: Cut the chicken into uniform 1-inch cubes. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for at least 30 minutes to prevent burning during cooking. This ensures even cooking.

instructions.title: Make the Marinade
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the plain yogurt, olive oil, minced garlic, tomato paste, sweet paprika, dried oregano, cumin powder, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice. Whisk until all ingredients are well combined and form a smooth paste. This is the heart of the flavor.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: Add the cubed chicken to the marinade bowl. Toss the chicken thoroughly, ensuring every piece is evenly coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or ideally overnight, to allow the flavors to penetrate deeply. Longer marination yields more tender and flavorful chicken.

instructions.title: Skewer the Chicken
instructions.text: Remove the chicken from the refrigerator. Thread the marinated chicken cubes onto the soaked wooden or metal skewers, leaving a small space between each piece for even cooking. Do not pack them too tightly.

instructions.title: Grill or Bake the Skewers
instructions.text: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat or your oven to 400°F (200°C). If grilling, cook the skewers for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through. If baking, place skewers on a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway, until chicken is cooked and lightly browned. Ensure internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).

instructions.title: Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Once cooked, remove the Tavuk Sis from the grill or oven. Let them rest for a few minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired. Serve hot with traditional Turkish sides like pilaf, cacik, fresh salad, or warm pita bread.

tips: For the most tender chicken, marinate it for at least 4 hours, or even better, overnight. The yogurt helps to tenderize the meat beautifully.
Do not overcrowd your grill or baking sheet. Cook the skewers in batches if necessary to ensure proper browning and even cooking.
Serve Tavuk Sis immediately after cooking to enjoy its full flavor and juiciness. A squeeze of fresh lemon juice just before serving enhances the taste.
